617:t_040:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I know that! But I won't let you spout some worthless line about revenge being empty!」

617:t_040:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's not it, $$バルビエル$$! Creating something is stronger than hatred that takes things away!」

617:t_040:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「And you, who couldn't find that...」

617:t_040:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Shut up, $$セツコ$$! Don't look at me with those eyes!」

617:t_040:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you can't do that, kill me! Try to stop this $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$!」

617:t_040:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's your weakness! But my hatred is infinite! I'll come back to kill you all, without fail!」

617:t_041:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「That bastard...! He just says whatever he wants!」

617:t_041:2.en:
$$シン$$
「It's all right, $$セツコ$$. If he comes back, all of us will take him on again.」

617:t_041:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$バルビエル$$... I'll fight you until the day that hatred reaches its end.)

617:t_042:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
($$バルビエル$$ has reached his limit... His $$スフィア$$'s power won't grow any further...)

617:t_043:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
(How pitiful, $$バルビエル$$. I cannot give that $$スフィア$$ to your self-righteousness.)

617:t_044:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're good, $c. You've pushed my $$ハイアデス$$ elites this far.」

617:t_044:1.en:
$$葵$$
「You've come out, $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

617:t_044:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「We'll knock you, their Supreme Commander, flat and crush the Empire right here!」

617:t_044:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I know we both have things we're carrying on our shoulders...」

617:t_044:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But for now, let's forget them and enjoy ourselves to the fullest! Darling, $c!」

617:t_044:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「No deal! We're settling this right now, $$エルーナルーナ$$!!」

617:t_045:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your men got beaten, and now the heat's on you, huh, $$尸空#pilot$$!」

617:t_045:3.en:
$$桂$$
「He's his usual self even in the decisive battle... The man never has any charm.」

617:t_045:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Leave it, $$桂$$. We don't care what his situation is.」

617:t_045:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll just beat him fast and drag out $$アウストラリス$$!」

617:t_046:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You're idiots. Do you want me to execute you that badly?」

617:t_046:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's a foolish strategy, $$新地球皇国$$. You're deploying forces piecemeal because you're trapped by petty territorial instincts.」

617:t_046:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's not it, $$ゼロ$$. The other two were afraid of getting caught in my poison.」

617:t_046:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And I alone can dispose of all of you.」

617:t_046:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now... let's fulfill our promise at $$メガラニカ$$. Taste the full extent of my hatred!」

617:t_046:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Bring it on! We're settling this today, so don't run!」

617:t_046:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll avenge the people who suffered from your cowardly methods!」

617:t_046:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If you fight for a personal feeling like hatred, that suits me! I can repay my debt to you without reservation!」

617:t_046:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$! Our battle ends today!」

617:t_100:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「The day has finally come, Darling!」

617:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$! Are you going to take your anger over $$ダバラーン$$'s defeat out on me?!」

617:t_100:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm not doing that! $$ハイアデス$$ lives in battle and dies in battle!」

617:t_100:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I think $$ダバラーン$$ was satisfied, too! Getting to fight men like you, Darling!」

617:t_100:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「And you're satisfied with that too?!」

617:t_100:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Of course! But I want even greater satisfaction!」

617:t_100:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「And that, Darling, means winning!」

617:t_100:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Too bad, $$エルーナルーナ$$! However strong your desire is, that wish is out of the question!」

617:t_100:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「Just for today, I'll play by your rules! We'll go all the way!!」

617:t_101:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$... You are...」

617:t_101:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'll kill you...! That's my love, $$セツコ$$!」

617:t_101:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You're wrong, $$バルビエル$$. That's nothing like love.」

617:t_101:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「People can't live on hatred alone! That's the last thing I can teach you!」

617:t_102:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is the decisive battle, $$尸空#pilot$$. Say something.」

617:t_102:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... You act like you're nothingness, but you can't hide your will to kill me.」

617:t_102:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Nothingness is not nonexistence. I am alive, too.」

617:t_102:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's a good thing to hear at the end. Now I'm getting fired up.」

617:t_102:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Fighting a silent killing machine isn't my thing...!」

617:t_102:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $$尸空#pilot$$! I'll teach you that even your nothingness can't swallow my determination to pay off my debt!」

617:t_103:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I believe you're wrong to direct your anger at me.」

617:t_103:2.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「I know that damn well! But...!」

617:t_103:3.en:
$$ガドライト#pilot$$
「Before I defeat your master, I'm going to settle things in my own heart!」

617:t_104:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Now then, like it or not, this is our last battle on this planet!」

617:t_104:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Let's enjoy it to the fullest, $c! With the best battle ever!」

617:t_105:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Every last one of you...! Do you live just to irritate me?!」

617:t_105:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then I'll erase you! Everything but me, with this $$アン・アーレス$$' poison!!」

617:t_106:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Today, everything ends, and everything begins...」

617:t_107:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」
